The paper gives the theoretical maximum for LiCoO2/graphite cells as 387 Wh/kg[2], so the anode-free cell exceeds that limit by about 13[3] Wh/kg. The state-of-the-art sodium-ion full cells the paper cites reach only ∼200 Wh/kg[4] with respect to active mass.
